_about: 2026-10-23 (package OPT2, owner 22:23, OPT-1: "use logic first - must be related, cannot be selected leaders or boss cards for future skirmishes, cannot be strange Map 40+ cards etc. maybe have similar attacks like arrows in an arrow map - that really limits the number of cards to prob 5-25."): the rules that pick phase 2's candidate cards for a map in tools/opt/deckopt.js. A card outside the map's phase-1 pool (its own cards and what a player owns by then) is a candidate when no exclusion hits it and its relatedness score reaches minScore. The best maxCards by score (then the nearest obtain map, then the id) are kept; when fewer than minCards qualify, minScore drops one step at a time (the output says so). Edit the numbers and lists here; deckopt reads this file from the game checkout (--rules FILE for another).
_weights: Points per kind of relatedness. biome: the card's biome (canonical/unit-themes.json) is the map's; kinBiome: a kin biome of the map's (unit-themes vocab, either way). terrainType: a unit type matches a fight's terrain types (it gets the terrain's bonus). sharedType: a unit type at least sharedTypeMin of the map's own cards have (cap sharedTypeCap). animalGroup: the same animal group as one of the map's cards. mechanic: a skill family at least mechanicMin of the map's cards have (cap mechanicCap), e.g. ranged skills on an arrow map. fieldMechanic: a skill family the map's field rewards (fieldFamilies below).
_ignoreTypes: Unit types too broad to say anything about a map.
_families: Skill families: engine effect keys that play alike. A card is in a family when it has any of the keys. Flying, Diurnal and Nocturnal alone count only through fieldFamilies (they are on too many cards to make a map's theme).
_familiesFieldOnly: Families that count only through the field (never as the map's own mechanic theme).
_fieldFamilies: A field rule (canonical fight rules, arena_app.js fightRules) and the skill families it rewards. Wind acts on Flyers (tailwind / headwind); the Tide and wet fields on Tide cards; Mist hides, so evasion; a day / night cycle the Diurnal and Nocturnal cards.
_exclude: Never a candidate. maxObtainMap: the card's first obtainable map (HUB3 plan adv, else canonical/card-obtain-maps.json) must be at most this (owner: no Map 40+ cards). buckets: plan buckets that are not ordinary obtainable cards. flags: card fields that mark strange cards (hidden, Easter eggs, the world boss, raid units, ranked monsters, Devilry summons, spells, equipment, Materia, hazards, field cards, cards still waiting for a source, Ecclesia prayers). futureLeaders / futureShowcase / futureBossOnly / futureBossRewards: a later map's fight leaders, its showcased cards, cards met only in later boss fights, and the rewards of later boss and map-ender fights (owner: not the selected leaders or boss cards of future skirmishes). A faction reward's obtain map waits for its rarity's gate (FACTION_RARITY_GATES). challengeRewards: SS challenge cards (canonical source challenge:true). specialTier: any map's SPECIAL tier (canonical/map-pools.json).
